description: The bar chart, titled "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks," compares the performance of two models—LLaMA-3-8B-it (blue bars) and Ours (Iterative RLHF) (orange bars)—across nine different datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis lists the datasets and metrics, including GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis represents the score in percentage, ranging from 0 to 80. For each dataset, two bars are shown side-by-side, with the blue bar representing LLaMA-3-8B-it and the orange bar representing the proposed model. In most benchmarks, the orange bar (Ours) is taller than the blue bar (LLaMA-3-8B-it), indicating superior performance. The highest scores are observed on the GSM-8K benchmark, where both models achieve scores above 80%, with the proposed model slightly outperforming LLaMA-3-8B-it. On the other hand, the lowest scores are seen on the Chat-Arena-Hard benchmark, where both models score below 30%, with the proposed model again showing a slight edge. The chart visually demonstrates that the proposed iterative RLHF method consistently outperforms the baseline LLaMA-3-8B-it model across all evaluated benchmarks.
